name: AutoXSEO — SEO on autopilot
author: AutoXSEO

sections.description:
AutoXSEO does the work of an SEO team for you:

  • Checks every page, post and product, and fixes search titles, descriptions and image descriptions.
  • Adds one connected schema graph (Organization, WebSite, Article, Product, FAQ, Breadcrumbs).
  • Publishes /llms.txt and lets AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini) read your site.
  • Plans and publishes helpful articles with images — or saves them for your approval.
  • “Write it for me” under the editor: add the basics, one click fills in everything.
  • Saves new uploads as fast WebP images.
  • Sends you a simple report by email.
  • Site Guard: emails you within minutes if your site goes down or is accidentally hidden from Google.
  • Ideas from your readers: questions asked in comments and site searches become articles or answers on the page.
  • Money pages: star up to three pages and they get fixed first, linked from new articles and refreshed monthly.

Adds nothing to your visitors’ page speed: no front-end scripts or styles, only meta tags and JSON-LD.

External service

This plugin connects to the AutoXSEO service (https://api.autoxseo.com) to analyse your content and generate improvements. Nothing is sent until you click Connect. After that, it sends:

  • Your published posts, pages and products: titles, content, excerpts, SEO fields and image URLs.
  • The text of approved comments (never commenter names, emails or IP addresses), to find the questions your readers ask.
  • What visitors type into your site’s search box (the words only, counted on your server; no visitor data, no tracking script).

All requests go from your server to AutoXSEO; nothing is loaded in your visitors’ browsers. Disconnecting stops all of it, and uninstalling removes the plugin’s settings and search log. Terms: https://autoxseo.com/terms · Privacy: https://autoxseo.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Click “Connect”. That’s it — autopilot starts.
sections.faq:
Is it free?

Yes, there’s a free plan: a full check of your site, up to 30 fixes and one article with images, so you can see it work on your own site. Paid plans keep it going every week.

Will it slow my site down?

No. AutoXSEO adds no scripts or stylesheets to your pages — only meta tags and structured data in the page head. All the work happens on AutoXSEO’s servers.

Does it write content without my approval?

Only if you want it to. Choose “Ask me first” and every fix and article waits for your OK (you can even approve from the email).

What happens if I stop using it?

Everything it did stays: titles, descriptions, image descriptions and articles are saved in WordPress like your own edits.

Can I undo changes?

Yes. Every change can be undone from your AutoXSEO dashboard.

I use another SEO plugin.

AutoXSEO won’t print duplicate tags while another SEO plugin is active. Import your titles and descriptions in one click, then let AutoXSEO take over.
sections.changelog:
1.2.2

  • The AutoXSEO menu now sits below the core WordPress menus.
  • Structured data (JSON-LD) output is fully escaped.

1.2.1

  • Your AutoXSEO dashboard now knows straight away when the plugin is switched off, switched back on or deleted, so it never shows a stale “Connected”.

1.2.0

  • New, calmer AutoXSEO screen that matches WordPress, read top to bottom.
  • Every fix explains why it was made.
  • Reader questions from comments and site searches; answers can be added to the page as a visible FAQ.
  • Site Guard status.

1.1.0

  • Articles get a featured image plus up to 3 images inside the text, placed where they help the reader.

1.0.0

  • First release.
